podcast.body: This album was recorded with Matt Skiba as guitarist, replacing Tom Delonge. The band developed 28 songs quickly and completed the recording session within three months, releasing the album on July 1, 2016. The rapid and "old-school Blink" approach proved successful, with the album reaching the top 10 in 13 countries. "They came up with 28 songs in very short order, burned through the recording session in three months and released it on July 1, 2016."

It achieved significant commercial success, becoming the group's second number one album on the Billboard 200 and their first in the UK, also hitting number one in Canada and the US, number two in Australia and Austria, and top 10 in six other countries. The album went gold, was nominated for a Grammy, and was described as Blink 182's biggest hit in a couple of decades, reinvigorating the band. "There was an album called California that became the group's second number one album on the Billboard 200 and their first in the UK."
